messages:
kevin: FYI I just hit a case where an embeddings-only API key successfully called a chat route. unsure if it's a client bug or server-side scope enforcement regression. attaching minimal repro.

kevin: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \\ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-embeddings-only-abc' \\ 
  -d '{"model":"chat-xyz","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'

sanjay: whoa, can you repro in prod/staging?

kevin: repro'd in prod this morning (10:12). low volume but consistent for that key id.

maria: checking audit logs for that key id now. if it touched chat route we should have an access_log entry. give me 5.

audit-bot: found 1 match for key=sk-embeddings-only-abc -> route=/v1/chat/completions ts=2026-11-03T10:12:07Z user=svc-ingest-1 action=ALLOW

maria: confirmed — audit shows server returned 200 for chat call. looks like scope enforcement returned ALLOW.

olivia: any recent RBAC or auth middleware deploys? I thought we tightened per-route scopes last quarter.

infra: small auth change 2 days ago that touched the token validation path to speed up lookups. rolled behind a feature flag but may have a fallback path. looking at rollout notes.

kevin: minimal repro attached above. behavior: if token has only [embeddings:read] it should 403 on chat; instead it succeeds and returns chat tokens.

sanjay: possible causes: 1) fallback to legacy scope map when new cache misses, 2) route-match mismatch (embeddings vs chat), 3) KMS key-id mapping changed and we validated signature but used wrong scope set.

maria: audit shows key mapped to service-account id svc-embed-42. that service account has roles: [embeddings_client]. no chat role. so how did enforcement pass?

olivia: does the enforcement code compare route->required_scopes as OR vs AND? might be allowing if any scope intersects. that would be a logic bug.

kevin: quick grep in prod fallback branch showed this snippet: 
```
if (!scopesFound) {
  // fallback: assume token has minimal scopes to not break traffic
  allow = true
}
```
not sure when that landed.

infra: oof. that explains it. feature-flagged change had a safety fallback that was too permissive. We'll revert the flag immediately.

eric-oncall: opening incident INC-2026-145 now, tagging sec-eng and infra. mitigation: flip flag, expire affected keys, rotate KMS if necessary.

kevin: mitigation note — expiring keys will break legitimate embeddings clients; recommend short TTL + grace window. we should also patch enforcement before mass key rotation.

maria: agreed. plan: 1) revert permissive fallback in prod (hotfix) 2) add deterministic unit + e2e test for per-route scope enforcement 3) run targeted key expiry for any keys seen abusing chat route 4) add audit alert if embeddings-key used on chat.

olivia: add KMS concern: if key-id remapping occurred during rotation the code path that canonicalizes key -> scopes might have returned empty scopes, triggering the fallback. we need to check KMS rotation log and key metadata.

infra: checking KMS rotations for svc-embed-42 — none in the last 90 days. there was a metadata migration two weeks ago that touched key aliases. could be related.

sanjay: action items (short):
- infra: revert flag and post deploy status (ETA 15m)
- maria/kevin: detect all keys that hit chat route in last 24h + audit export (CSV)
- olivia: write quick policy test and add to preflight (PR after hotfix)
- eric-oncall: create incident page + customer comm draft if this affects external tenants

kevin: adding snippet for an audit alert we can add to alertmanager: 
```yaml
- alert: EmbeddingsKeyUsedOnChatRoute
  expr: sum(rate(api_requests{route=~"/v1/chat.*",key_type="embeddings"}[5m])) > 0
  for: 1m
  labels:
    severity: critical
  annotations:
    summary: "Embeddings API key used on chat route"
    runbook: "/runbooks/embeddings_scope_mismatch"
```

maria: I'll export the key list now and DM it to infra + sec-eng.

infra: flag reverted, rolling restart in 12 nodes, should be steady within 7m.

audit-bot: deploy-event user=infra action=FLAG_REVERT flag=auth-cache-fallback ts=2026-11-03T10:20:31Z

eric-oncall: hotfix deployed and smoke tests show 403 on chat for embeddings-only keys. marking mitigation in incident. next step: patch code to remove permissive fallback and add explicit fail closed behavior.

olivia: I'll open PR with test and static analysis note. want a small backport to the stable branch.

sanjay: we should also add a periodic audit that validates token_id->scopes mapping against KMS aliases to catch remapping bugs.

kevin: thanks all. I'll follow up with the smoke repro and the list of affected keys. please escalate if you see any false positives in the next hour. :thumbsup:

maria: uploaded CSV -> s3://redwood-audit/INC-2026-145/keys.csv (restricted). sharing to infra/sec.

eric-oncall: incident updated. closing thread here, will reopen if further regressions observed.
